desc: The TC73 Rifle is proudly brought to you by Taylor’s & Co. Firearms. 100% Made in the USA, the TC73 is an 1873 lever action rifle designed with performance in mind while maintaining the historic features of the lever gun that we all know and love. The addition of 9MM to the 1873 Lever Action family is something Taylor’s aimed to bring to market and it’s incredible to do it right here in the USA with 100% US made parts and finishing. Bringing the 1873 home to America. As lever guns get the accolades they deserve from sportsmen all over – the TC73 is sure not to disappoint. The high quality standards Taylor’s strives for is represented in the TC73 and it is sure to win the hearts of like-minded gun enthusiasts.
